items.title: AStockArena: Beyond Returns, Can We Entrust Real Capital to the Decisions of Financial Agents?
items.claim: Seventy-three percent of audited trading decisions contain at least one audit gap, and portfolio outcomes shift when flagged trades are removed.

items.title: Do Earnings Calls Help Predict Financial Restatements? Evaluating Text Beyond Public Firm Information
items.claim: Earnings-call text flags restatements but adds no ranking gain over public firm information, while LLMs leak tickers and use future knowledge.

items.title: Where Causal Discovery Breaks on Real Data: Measuring the Assumptions One Property at a Time
items.claim: On real corporate-action data, tuned causal discovery underperforms simple cross-correlation within actions, and most direct pairs lack statistical power.

items.title: RiskReason: A Benchmark for Verifiable Financial Risk Reasoning
items.claim: High financial-risk reasoning accuracy hides incorrect decisions, broken state propagation, and constraint violations that aggregate scores conceal.
